send: i=0; while [ "$(getprop sys.boot_completed)" != 1 ] && [ $i -lt 900 ]; do sleep 3; i=$((i+3)); done; echo BOOTDONE=$(getprop sys.boot_completed); sleep 45

echo ===NV-KERNEL-BEGIN===; uname -r; for m in nvidia nvidia-modeset nvidia-drm nouveau; do printf '%s ' $m; su 0 modinfo /vendor/lib/modules/$m.ko | grep -E '^vermagic' | tr -s ' ' | cut -d' ' -f2; done; echo ===NV-KERNEL-END===

echo ===NV-BLOCKLIST-BEGIN===; su 0 grep -E 'nvidia|nouveau' /vendor/lib/modules/modules.blocklist; echo load:$(su 0 grep -cE '^(nvidia|nouveau)' /vendor/lib/modules/modules.load); echo live:$(su 0 grep -cE '^(nvidia|nvidia_modeset|nvidia_drm|nouveau) ' /proc/modules); su 0 cat /vendor/lib/modules/modules.options 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'nvidia|nouveau'; echo ===NV-BLOCKLIST-END===

echo ===NV-FIRMWARE-BEGIN===; su 0 ls -l /vendor/firmware/nvidia/615.78.08/ /vendor/firmware/LICENSES/ | grep -iE 'nvidia|gsp|ucode'; su 0 sha256sum /vendor/firmware/nvidia/615.78.08/gsp_ga10x.bin /vendor/firmware/nvidia/615.78.08/ucodes_ga10x.bin /vendor/firmware/LICENSES/LICENSE.nvidia-driver-615.78.08; echo ===NV-FIRMWARE-END===
echo ===NV-UEVENTD-BEGIN===; su 0 grep -E 'nvidia' /odm/etc/ueventd.rc; su 0 ls -lZ /dev/nvidia* 2>&1 | head -5; echo ===NV-UEVENTD-END===

echo ===NV-PROPS-BEGIN===; for p in vendor.openbook.gfx.mode vendor.openbook.gfx-kms persist.vendor.openbook.dgpu_driver vendor.openbook.dgpu.ready ro.gfx.driver.0 init.svc.vendor.openbook.dgpu-driver init.svc.vendor.openbook.gfx-boot init.svc.vendor.openbook.gfx-booted; do echo "$p=$(getprop $p)"; done; echo ===NV-PROPS-END===
echo ===NV-LOG-BEGIN===; su 0 logcat -d -b all | grep -E 'dgpu-driver|openbook-gfx-mode|openbook-pc-setup' | tail -30; su 0 dmesg | grep -iE 'nvidia|nouveau|NVRM' | head -20; echo ===NV-LOG-END===
echo ===NV-AVC-BEGIN===; su 0 dmesg | grep 'avc:  denied' | grep -iE 'nvidia|gpu|gfx|dgpu|modprobe|sysfs_gpu' | head -20; echo count:$(su 0 dmesg | grep -c 'avc:  denied'); echo ===NV-AVC-END===
